evidence.check: IF-003 surface of the unit screens
evidence.result: src/features/diagnosis/* contain no direct fetch() or /api/ literal. Diagnosis calls go through diagnosesApi (IF-003 routes: POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses, GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/diagnoses/:id, POST /api/diagnoses/:id/complete). Exception: QuestionnairePage.tsx imports getCompany from companiesApi for the header name (finding, scope, medium).

server/services/diagnosisService.ts incomplete() -> DomainError(422, 'incomplete', ..., { pendingBlocks }); server/http/errorHandler.ts spreads error.details beside code and message into the error body, so the client receives error.pendingBlocks. httpClient.readErrorDetails folds those extra keys into ApiError.details, and readPendingBlocks reads them.

evidence.ref: R1 (high): a server-detected incomplete diagnosis never shows the pending-blocks alert; httpClient dropped error.pendingBlocks
evidence.observed: httpClient.ts readErrorDetails (lines 66-70) now keeps the extra error keys, so the 422 list reaches ApiError.details. The probe 'R1 server shape' reads [1..8] with exactly one request. diagnosesApi.withPendingBlocks (lines 80-91) remains as a defensive fallback for a missing list and is covered by the all-invalid case. Gate path: CompletionGate.tsx runCompletion (lines 101-120) -> readPendingBlocks -> PendingAlert.

messages.text: httpClient.ts is outside this unit's file list (it is in the lane write path src/**). The implementer changed it: readErrorDetails folds extra error keys into ApiError.details, and request() sends Content-Type application/json on POST/PUT/PATCH. QA made no change to it. The probe confirms the pendingBlocks and start/complete behavior. Other callers (companies, history archive/restore) rely on the folded details shape, so confirm them in their QA.

Run the deferred checks with the backend up and a browser available: pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts. Expected: answer, reload and see the same answers plus 'Salvo automaticamente às HH:MM'; 'Ver meu resultado' with gaps shows role=alert with links ?bloco=N; with everything answered, 'Concluir o diagnóstico?' opens and Cancelar keeps the draft; 'Descartar rascunho' confirm/cancel shows the createdAt date.

Decide whether QuestionnairePage's company-name header may read GET /api/companies/:id through companiesApi (IF-002). The Done-when line names IF-003 only. If not, the screen should take the name from the IF-003 response or fall back to the generic label.
